claims.text: Digitalization and AI make data center water use increasingly important globally; the study examines liters consumed per workload to guide conservation.

Workload-level consumption varies by more than 10,000-fold, reflecting more than 1,000-fold variation in water consumed per kWh of server electricity and roughly tenfold variation in server workload efficiency.

In descending importance the determinants are server efficiency, grid water consumption factor, server utilization, cooling system type, infrastructure efficiency, climate zone, inactive server percentage, and refresh cycle.
Notably, there is no single recipe for minimizing water use; instead, optimal outcomes depend on tailored combinations of these factors.

claims.text: The lower-WUE cluster comprises direct expansion, stand-alone air-cooled chillers and the airside economizer variants with air-cooled backup, including direct adiabatic cooling. Its limited consumption often reflects occasional humidification or sporadic adiabatic cooling; the authors attribute the latter pattern to major internet operators' advanced practices.

support.text: Figure S6.2 shows this group toward the low end of a linear WUE-site axis.

claims.text: The higher-WUE cluster contains the five configurations with water-cooled chillers and the liquid IT dry cooler with adiabatic assist and air-cooled backup. Towers or wet-mode dry cooling account for its higher consumption.

The liquid IT dry-cooler configuration has the lowest WUE-site within this higher group because warmer facility water permits dry operation much of the year, restricting wet mode to a small share of hours.

reading_path.meaning: The linear-scale view clarifies how actual heat rejection, including the frequency of wet operation, separates the groups.

claims.text: Overlapping temperature allowances let free or adiabatic cooling suffice most of the year, even in warmer or humid zones, with nearly identical metrics at similar UPS and pump efficiencies. support.text: Figure S7.1 shows high efficiency along the lower boundary, consistent with the prose associating the highest efficiency with the lowest site intensities. Its caption lists low and high efficiency against minimum and maximum server electricity in the opposite order.

claims.text: The source WUE relationship is linear in WCF at fixed PUE and in PUE at fixed WCF; geothermal and wind give the highest and lowest source WUE in the worked examples.
